summary: Rewrite analysis.py as nested-CV kNN on the 12 standardised raw features (tune k and weights only), run pilot-only, write cv_auc alone
reasoning: Design is pilot-only: pipeline StandardScaler+KNN (n_jobs=1), grid over n_neighbors {3,5,7,9,11,15,21,31,51} x weights {uniform,distance} — only k and weighting, as the route prescribes. cv_auc comes from nested CV: inner 5-fold GridSearchCV per outer 5-fold split, AUC averaged over outer folds (seed fixed, so the final run reproduces it exactly). The earlier knn route (synth-r2-knn#step-9) reached cv_auc 0.8568 with an extra feature screen, so all-raw should be near that; 8 of 12 features likely carry signal, so I expect cv_auc >= 0.8. Data facts used: 1000 pilot rows, 12 features, balanced labels, sklearn 1.9.1. Heldout is not opened; out/metrics.json gets only cv_auc. ~450 small unthreaded KNN fits, minutes at most.
